name: HoloMedicine® Education
summary:
HoloMedicine® Education brings medical imaging data into mixed reality for learning, training, and exploration. Designed for medical students, residents, educators, surgical trainees, allied health learners, and anyone studying human anatomy in 3D.

# FEATURES

- DICOM visualization (CT, MR, PET, SPECT, US, XA) with multiplanar reconstruction — axial, coronal, sagittal
- Interactive 3D anatomical models and 2D media (images, videos, PDFs)
- Crop, rotate, and window/level adjustments (CT presets: Bone, Lung,
